style: 証人は匿名。外見・年齢感・性別の描画・衣装は美術設定で、依頼人サイや鏡の中の話者とは同定しない。写し・筆記具・机・鏡・影を人物画へ固定しない。

files.prompt_en:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent full-body character portrait for a Japanese fantasy adventure game
Scene/backdrop: fully transparent background, isolated figure only
Style/medium: finely drawn ink outlines, soft layered watercolor and opaque painted shading, restrained storybook fantasy illustration, warm natural skin tones and nuanced fabric folds
Primary request: an anonymous witness who receives a written copy of testimony outside a large mirror. Standing calmly with empty hands loosely brought together at waist height, attentive serious expression and slightly inclined head.
Subject: an adult man with short dark curly hair, a broad gentle face, medium brown skin, a plain muted moss green knee-length coat worn open over a sandstone linen shirt, charcoal trousers and worn dark brown ankle boots. Modest unadorned clothing and a compact relaxed silhouette.
Composition/framing: vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, entire standing figure and both hands visible, head in upper fifth with generous transparent margin above, narrow balanced silhouette within central 65 percent, feet fully inside canvas. Three-quarter front view, readable face at small display size.
Lighting/mood: soft even illumination, careful attention and quiet responsibility
Constraints: exactly one person, empty hands, transparent alpha around the entire silhouette. No other people, mirror, shadows, papers, books, writing tools, desk, chairs, personal emblems, floor, background, lettering or watermark. Appearance and clothing are art direction only; do not invent a name, personal history or a shared identity with the client or the voices within the mirror.
files.prompt_ja: 日本語ファンタジーADV用の透過全身人物画。繊細なインク線、水彩の重なりと不透明な塗りの柔らかな陰影による抑制した物語画。温かな肌色と細やかな布のしわ。大鏡の外で証言の写しを預かる匿名の証人。空いた両手を腰の高さでゆるく寄せ、少し頭を傾け、真剣に相手へ耳を傾けながら落ち着いて立つ。短い暗色の巻き毛、幅のある穏やかな顔、褐色の肌の成人男性。簡素なくすんだ苔色の膝丈の上着を開け、砂岩色の麻のシャツ、墨色のズボン、履き込んだ暗い茶色の足首丈の靴。装飾を抑えた衣装と、力みのないまとまった輪郭。1024×1536の縦長画面に全身と両手を収め、頭を上部5分の1へ置き、上に透過余白を確保する。中央65％以内にまとまる輪郭、足先まで入る斜め前向きの構図。縮小時も顔が読み取れる。柔らかく均等な光、慎重な注意と静かな責任感。背景と輪郭の周囲を完全透過にする。人物は一人、手には物を持たせない。他の人物、鏡、影、紙、帳面、筆記具、机、椅子、個人の紋章、床、背景、文字、透かしを入れない。外見と衣装は美術設定であり、氏名、経歴、依頼人や鏡の中の声との同一性を創作しない。
